formal_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : Submodule ℂ (Fin m → ℂ)), (∀ x ∈ X, ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 0) → (∀ x ∈ X, ∑ i, x i ^ 4 = 0) → 3 * Module.finrank ℂ X ≤ m
plain_statement: If W in C^M has sum x_i^2 = 0 and sum x_i^4 = 0 for every x in W, then 3 dim W <= M. Not L-gct-061 (that one uses p3; dup.mjs flags it at 0.96 on text similarity only). Sharp: blocks (1, w, w^2), w a cube root of unity. Paper proof: W o W is totally isotropic and orthogonal to 1; Kneser for codes (checked L-gct-065) blockwise as in L-gct-061. Used in the self-gluable 4 x s analysis of L-gct-086.
title: Lemma K: a complex linear space on which the power sums p2 and p4 both vanish has dimension at most M/3 (p4, not p3: distinct from L-gct-061)
